status: Proposed acceptance targets; not measured hardware capabilities

host-contract.scope: P01/P02 orchestration, pure core contracts, strict capability preflight and native offline fixtures; no device I/O

desktop.scope: Browser UI adapter and Mac application backend; automated Cucumber UI bindings pending; bounded fixture adapter available, full application qualification pending

native.scope: Independent native C++ engine with bounded local IPC, prepared graph, paced virtual audio and compiled guarded host-backend ports; real output/capture and full native application qualification pending

os-vm.scope: Dedicated P10 adapter: booted Linux x86_64 console with guest core rendering, ext4 persistence and HDA WAV capture; graphical UI/native real-time parity/MPC drivers remain pending. Pure host adapters still refuse this profile.

usb-lab.scope: Authorized Live Mk1 already running a reviewed XMP lab build; transport and agent pending

measurementRules.workload: Four sampled drum tracks and four basic subtractive-synth tracks, up to 32 total active voices, EQ and filter inserts on each track, one shared tempo delay and one shared reverb; note/event fixture and settings must be frozen and hashed before qualification.
measurementRules.overloadWorkload: Twice the qualified voice demand; the documented bounded voice/graph refusal policy must be measured separately.
measurementRules.capture: The control link is not an audio measurement. Physical latency requires calibrated external loopback capture and an explicit clock-offset/drift method.
measurementRules.temperature: Record ambient/device temperatures and throttling evidence; freeze board-appropriate thermal limits after hardware identification. An unset required thermal limit blocks qualification.
measurementRules.changes: Budgets are proposed. Record an explicit product decision and versioned profile change before revising them; never silently relax a threshold after a failed run.

p04-mac-development-v1.workload: 32 prepared looping sample voices, four per track, gain buses and master clipping; no synth/effect-chain V1 qualification

host-lab-development-v1.transport: owned Unix socket with mutual TLS 1.3
host-lab-development-v1.qualification: host software only; exact-unit and physical evidence pending

p12-host-sampler-soak-v1.workload: Prepared looping samples only; final synth/effect workload and eight-hour V1 qualification pending

p12-owned-vm-update-v1.storage: Owned workspace file snapshots and atomic active pointer; no MPC partition assumptions
